title: EXP-033 — Select Form Native Keyboard Filter Refresh Diagnostic
objective: Against the existing live Web Client, use one Select Form dialog without any tested Cancel/reopen cycle. Record its inherited state, establish Filter By=Name with Case Sensitive unchecked and Starts With unchecked, clear the filter through supported native keyboard interaction, and type `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` one printable character at a time using the native keyboard path. Verify that the settled rendered grid shows the known-existing exact Name row. Only if that positive control passes, clear the textbox through the same supported keyboard path and type `FX_SelectFormKeyboardProbe01` one printable character at a time, then inspect the settled rendered grid for visible case-insensitive Name matches. Do not press Enter or OK, activate a row, use JavaScript or internal stores, or infer database absence. Across the whole experiment, ambiguity recovery is limited to one fresh untargeted snapshot plus one corrected visible inspection total; task or worker-session boundaries do not reset that budget.

in_scope: Read the decisive EXP-031 evidence and record before acting, especially its retained-text/stale-row result and final dismissed-dialog state
Preserve all inherited Web Client and Designer Form state without Mongoose artifact mutation
Use only the supported rendered Web Client Select Form dialog
Record whether Select Form is initially open and its inherited filter text, Filter By value, Case Sensitive state, Starts With state, and rendered rows
If Select Form is initially closed, perform at most one ordinary Open solely to enter this diagnostic; if already open, use it without an extra lifecycle reset
Establish Filter By=Name, Case Sensitive unchecked, and Starts With unchecked through supported rendered controls before the positive-control test

Focus the current rendered Name-filter textbox, select its text with native Ctrl+A, and clear it with native Backspace; resolve the visible textbox with current accessibility references and verify focus, without bulk fill or clipboard paste

Type `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` through supported native key presses, one printable character per key operation, including its underscores and digits. If the available tools cannot issue this exact native keyboard path, stop blocked without substituting bulk fill, paste, JavaScript, or run-code
Inspect and capture the settled positive-control result; require a visible row whose Name exactly equals `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` before proceeding

Only after the positive control passes, clear the focused filter with native Ctrl+A followed by Backspace and type `FX_SelectFormKeyboardProbe01` through the same one-printable-character-per-key-operation path. This experiment must never create the probe or presume its database absence
Inspect and capture the settled probe result for visible case-insensitive Name matches
Use rendered screenshots/accessibility observations as decisive evidence; naturally available request/response evidence may be retained only as corroboration

Normal planned preflight, current-reference/focus checks, positive-control/probe result captures, and final evidence are permitted. Separately, ambiguity recovery allows only one additional fresh untargeted snapshot plus one corrected visible inspection total across the entire run, shared by both strings and all tasks; ordinary evidence capture never authorizes repeated stale reads or resets that allowance
After all permitted inspection is complete, allow at most one ordinary final Cancel solely to dismiss Select Form, with no subsequent reopen
Write evidence only under `evidence/EXP-033/` and the EXP-033 experiment record

Starting any other experiment or replay

Repeat an ambiguous or stale inspection after the one experiment-wide additional fresh-snapshot plus corrected-inspection recovery allowance is exhausted; do not relabel repeated stale reads as normal evidence capture or reset the allowance through a task/session handoff

acceptance_checks.description: Preflight evidence proves a usable live Web Client Select Form workflow, records whether the dialog was initially open plus its inherited filter/settings/rendered rows, accounts for at most one initial Open if needed, and proves inherited Web Client/Designer Forms remained untouched with no Mongoose artifact mutation or session-establishment action.

Positive-control evidence shows Filter By=Name, Case Sensitive unchecked, Starts With unchecked, and exact text `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` entered into the focused current textbox after native Ctrl+A/Backspace clearing, using one printable character per supported native key operation. The settled rendered grid visibly contains a row whose Name exactly equals `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`. If the native input path is unavailable or this result cannot be established within the shared recovery budget, stop blocked without starting the probe or switching input mechanisms.

Only after AC-2 passes, probe evidence shows exact text `FX_SelectFormKeyboardProbe01` entered after native Ctrl+A/Backspace clearing through the same one-printable-character-per-native-key-operation path, with Filter By=Name and both checkboxes unchecked. The settled rendered grid contains zero visible case-insensitive Name matches. The probe is only a test string, not proof of an uncreated database object. If matching rows appear or the result remains stale/ambiguous within the shared recovery budget, record it and stop blocked without retyping or lifecycle retry. Any zero-match finding is limited to this inspected UI state.

For a successful full execution, action evidence proves both tested strings were cleared with native Ctrl+A/Backspace and entered one printable character per supported native key operation. No bulk value injection, clipboard paste, Enter, OK, row activation, JavaScript, internal-store access, synthetic DOM mutation, or tested Cancel/reopen cycle is permitted. For an early stop, record only actual input actions and unperformed steps rather than claiming both strings were tested.

The whole run reconciles one shared ambiguity-recovery budget of at most one additional fresh untargeted snapshot plus one corrected visible inspection total across all tasks and both strings. Distinguish normal planned preflight, current-reference/focus checks, result captures, and final evidence from extra recovery reads; repeated unchanged/stale reads cannot be relabeled as normal capture. Record where the shared recovery allowance was used and what remains. Worker/session changes do not reset it; ambiguity remaining after that allowance causes a blocked outcome without another input attempt, inspection loop, or lifecycle retry.

Final audit records the final filter/settings/rendered result, accounts for at most one final ordinary Cancel solely to dismiss Select Form with no subsequent reopen, proves repository changes are confined to the EXP-033 record plus `evidence/EXP-033/`, and confirms no Mongoose artifacts or inherited Forms were created, modified, activated, saved, closed, or reopened. A successful first execution is observed UI-level consistency between native-keyboard filter input and rendered results, not a verified preflight procedure; an independent clean replay is needed for verification. Do not infer a server refresh/requery or database absence from matching rendered results alone.

notes: Proposed after blocked run R-20261007-200942-NcTj. EXP-031 observed retained exact filter text/settings across Cancel/reopen, but the changed probe reopened with the prior rendered row still visible; its shared inspection allowance was also exceeded, so the run was not accepted and did not verify filtering. EXP-033 is a distinct artifact-read-only diagnostic: keep one Select Form instance open, clear its focused Name filter through native Ctrl+A/Backspace, and send each printable character through a separate supported native key operation. Bulk fill/paste and JavaScript are prohibited. The known-existing positive-control row must be established first, then a probe result consistent with its exact filter. Normal planned evidence and current-reference checks are distinct from the one additional shared ambiguity-recovery snapshot plus one corrected inspection; no task/session change resets that allowance. Success supplies one observed candidate preflight procedure requiring later independent replay, without repairing prior blocked experiments or asserting server requery, database absence, or uniqueness.
